findings.description: Forge exposes training/data/artifact management APIs, not dedicated LLM/VLM inference serving. adapter.py is a TrainingEvent extension Protocol, not the MedVLM model.generate adapter.
Template .jinja is excluded during Hub download and checkpoint ZIP export; .tiktoken/nested assets are also excluded from export.
Enabled training uses Unix fcntl host lease, Hub token save uses os.fchmod; documented validated training host is native Ubuntu CUDA, not Windows dashboard or Colab tunnel.
Historical GPU loss decreases were synthetic pipeline validation. Stored generated responses do not equal references; no medical answer or image diagnosis quality was established.

security_conclusion: No authentication bypass confirmed. Auth protections coherent under code review and 11 store tests; blocked HTTP attempts do not establish HTTP correctness.
